facts.note: Sat alone in the dining room with the brandy after dinner; at the temple's ten strokes his watch showed four minutes to ten.
Went out to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch; it stopped at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window above, with the piano playing all the while.
Came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; he went up to Félix in the library.

added.quote: I took it for Monnier showing the thing off, the way he does.
added.why: Places Monnier (as Girard supposes) at the master's window demonstrating the repeater at 10:34, a person's activity at a moment the sheet does not attribute to anyone. Only a supposition, but it gives a detective a whereabouts to test.

added.quote: Did you go up to the atelier at any time? / No. I had no reason to.
added.why: Girard states he never went to the atelier at any point that evening, a whereabouts claim across the whole evening that the sheet does not give.
